Reports

Daily market report archive

What each DappGo daily report said, session by session, for three markets.

DappGo publishes a daily research report for US stocks, Taiwan stocks and US options. The apps and web apps always show the latest report. This archive keeps a readable page for every past session, so you can see what the report measured on a given day and how the readings changed from one session to the next.

Each page is generated by code from one published report payload. It shows the session date, the time the report was generated, and a short hash that identifies the payload. The text describes the numbers and does not forecast. How the measurements are defined is set out in how DappGo computes its signals; who we are and how we handle corrections is in the editorial policy.
